harper: Quick heads-up — onboarding magnet20b-int3 hit a reproducible long-prefill drift when resuming KV from snapshot s-2026-09-15-anchorcheck. Short repro below.

joel: Numbers?

harper: Top-3 recall on our 9k anchor set drops 0.879 -> 0.854 (delta ~0.025) only on resume. Cold starts fine.

maria: Which snapshot change landed?

harper: We enabled `rotary_warp` (compact phase remap) + switched to int3 kernel path that reorders accumulation for size perf. Both in same roll.

joel: Repro command (use image rwinf/dev:magnet-canary):
```
python eval/prefill_anchor.py \
  --model magnet20b-int3 --snapshot s-2026-09-15-anchorcheck \
  --prompt tests/anchors/long-09.txt --max-tokens 9216 \
  --kvcache-mode resume --emit-json
```

Outputs: baseline top3 0.879, canary top3 0.854. Quick log snip: LOGIT_DIFF {"warp_tail": 0.0031, "accum_order_skew": 0.0012}.

maria: Try flags: `--disable-rotary-warp` and `--kvcache-deterministic-stitch`?

harper: Ran both on a canary node: disable-warp -> 0.876, deterministic-stitch -> 0.872, both -> 0.878. So interaction looks real.

joel: New idea: store a tiny per-snapshot "phase-anchor-checksum" (checksum of expected per-token phase anchors) and run a quick rehydrate-compare during snapshot commit. If checksum mismatch > eps, fail snapshot or force fp32 anchors. Low-overhead and cheap to compute.

maria: Love that — gives a numeric parity gate. Also add a nightly job to run `kv/anchor_probe` across new snapshots and upload histograms.

synth-bot: Canary s-2026-09-15-anchorcheck deployed to 3% at 2026-09-15T11:20:00Z. Metric flagged: longctx_top3_drop=0.025.

qa-bot: Queued regression job `anchor-int3-warp-smoke` x3: https://ci.redwood-internal/prefill/3098765432

harper: I'll prototype the phase-anchor-checksum in snapshot writer today and add a small preflight that rehydrates the first 9k tokens. If checksum differs, snapshot writer falls back to storing anchors in fp32.

ojel: I'll help add a unit test that simulates int3 accumulation ordering differences and verifies the checksum catches it.

maria: Pausing further canary ramp until we have the gate or a mitigation. Adding note to model onboarding checklist and the snapshot guide.

harper: Thanks — will paste the tiny reproducer prompt to the ticket. :memo:
